Weighted peer samplers and add, remove, update logic for CRDS contact info entries.

# Purpose
This file defines the sampler management code for CRDS contact info peers. It keeps one primary weighted sampler in `pr_sampler` and 25 bucket samplers in `bucket_samplers`, all stored in `crds_samplers_t`. The code also keeps a parallel `ele` array and a `sampler_idx` field in each `fd_crds_entry_t` so each peer has the same index across all samplers. That index mapping lets the code add, update, remove, and swap peers in one place while keeping the sampler state aligned with the CRDS contact info table.

The file implements a simple weighted sampling model in `wpeer_sampler`. It stores cumulative weights, uses `peer_enabled` to mark peers that are present but disabled, and provides functions to initialize the sampler, draw a sample, update a peer weight, disable or enable a peer, and remove a peer when the CRDS table drops it. The peer score uses stake, an active flag, and a time-based penalty for stale entries. The bucket score uses the peer stake bucket and the target bucket index. The `crds_samplers_*` functions apply these scoring rules to all samplers, so the gossip code can keep its peer selection sets in sync with CRDS updates.
